limitations.text: The early forms of 會 have been interpreted as 合 combined with a vessel and lid, but the central shape and the object it depicts remain disputed. The fragmentary oracle-bone example «會我» is only a possible use meaning “meet”; the available evidence does not establish a dated sequence from a vessel or lid sense to meeting. The later form 会 is recorded as a cursive-derived variant of 會, rather than an ancient 人-and-云 construction.
